description_html:
Wacom Cintiq pro


Create directly on a large canvas with premium color performance

Use the Wacom Cintiq Pro 24 for absolute harmony with your work. Premium 4K screen with world class color performance, and virtually no parallax, enhance every creative breakthrough. The Wacom Pro Pen 2 provides state-of-the-art creative pen technology, meaning every stroke, every move of your hand is followed with unerring accuracy.


Live. Dare. Create.


Our largest screens give you more space, more efficiency, more time.

Wacom Cintiq Pro 24 give you something priceless: space. So much, in fact, that you won't waste time searching for that reference image or opening and closing different programs on a secondary screen. And there'll be less zooming in and 

out too. Now you can save time and take control of your creativity, for a more efficient, controlled workspace.


No moving between different screens

No need to keep switching windows

Save time with less zooming in and out

Always see the whole picture


Stand up

Perfect for working your magic at a standing desk.


Sit down

Great for getting the job done while taking a load off.


Make room

Move it out of the way when you need some extra desk space.


Ideas jump off the screen

4K resolution (3840 x 2160 px) is packed into a 24” LCD display with superb color accuracy (99% of Adobe® RGB coverage, CIE1931). You can see every tiny detail of your greatest artwork, design or photographic projects.


A display that looks, and feels, totally natural

The etched glass screen provides a distinct, tactile experience as you draw, mimicking the feel of a pen on paper. And with minimized parallax, and a screen strong enough to resist ‘pooling’ and rippling, each mark appears precisely where you expect it, every time.


Designed to increase your productivity

As a creative professional, time’s rarely on your side. That’s why Wacom Cintiq Pro puts productivity solutions right at your fingertips.


Connect your way

Connect to any Mac or PC with a single USB-C cable (included) to a USB-C port for both video and data. DisplayPort or HDMI are also included, which require USB port for data.


Make it match you

The ExpressKey™ Remote puts 17 programmable buttons within easy reach. The on-screen keypad and the radial menus offer further one-touch shortcuts.


A natural interface

Pan, zoom or rotate your work with multi-touch gestures* - as simple as using your smartphone.


*Available on Wacom Cintiq Pro 24 touch model.



Great bundled creative apps

Gain up to 3 months complimentary access to selected bundled apps specially tailored for creative usage.


Get complimentary software offers with every Cintiq Pro


1-Toon Boom Harmony ( 3 months free )

2-Toon Boom Storyboard Pro ( 3 months free )

3- MASV ( 3 free months) (or 250 GB) )

4-Shapr3D ( 3 months free )

5-Bluescape ( 3 months free )


*To get your 90-day complimentary software you need to sign in with your Wacom ID, respectively create a Wacom ID account with your personal data, and register your device. To begin using the software after installation, registration with Toon Boom is required.

description_html_ar:
أداء متميز 

ارسم على شاشة 4k بمساحة 23.6 بوصة مع دقة ألوان رائعة تبلُغ 99% من معيار Adobe RGB 

يمكنك رؤية كل التفاصيل الصغيرة لأعظم أعمالك الفنية أو تصميماتك أو مشاريعك الفوتوغرافية مع شاشة Wacom Cintiq Pro 24 - Touch تعطيك الشاشة إحساس الرسم على الورق بإضافة احساس الإحتكاك، مع  جودة ودقة عالية مما يجعلها مثالية لكل شئ، بدءًا من الرسوم المتحركة ووصولاً إلى التصميم. 


ارسم على شاشة تعمل باللمس حيثُ يُمكنك تكبير / تصغير أو تدويره وذلك باستخدام إيماءات اللمس المتعدد* - بنفس سهولة استخدام هاتفك الذكي.


ExpressKey™ Remote 

يأتي مع الشاشة وحدة اختصارات مُنفصلة تحتوي على 17 زرًا يُمكنك تخصيصهم وفقاً لرغبتك.


اتصال سهل 

يُمكنك توصيل الشاشة بأجهزة : Windows 7 أو أحدث

macOS 10.11  أو أحدث 

من خلال توصيل كابل USB-C 

ويُمكنك أيضاً توصيله DisplayPort أو HDMI، ولكن يتطلب منفذ USB للبيانات.


تطبيقات رسم مجانية

احصل على وصول مجاني لمدة تصل إلى 3 أشهر إلى مجموعة مختارة من التطبيقات المصممة خصيصًا للاستخدام الإبداعي.


Toon Boom Harmony 

Toon Boom Storyboard Pro 

MASV (or 250 GB) 

 Shapr 3D 

Bluescape



*للحصول على البرنامج المجاني لمدة 90 يومًا، يتعين عليك تسجيل الدخول باستخدام معرف Wacom الخاص بك، وإنشاء حساب Wacom ID ببياناتك الشخصية، ثم تسجيل جهازك. لبدء استخدام البرنامج بعد التثبيت، يلزم التسجيل في Toon Boom.

specs.name: Ports Included
specs.value: 4 x USB3 ports*, 1 x USB C port, 1 x HDMI2.0 port, 1 x DisplayPort, 2 USB-A Ports (one for ExpressKey Remote dongle), audio headset jack, built-in microphone

specs.name: Hardware Requirements
specs.value: USB-C port with DisplayPort Alternate Mode (UHD), or Mini DisplayPort/DisplayPort (UHD) and USB-A, or HDMI 2.0 (UHD) and USB-A

specs.name: OS Support
specs.value:
PC: Windows® 7 or later (Latest service pack/ build)
Mac: macOS 10.11 or later (Latest update)

specs.name: What's Included
specs.value:
Wacom Cintiq Pro 24 -Touch
Wacom Pro Pen 2 with 4-color pen ring set
ExpressKey™ Remote (with USB-A RF dongle and 30cm micro-USB to USB charger cable)
Pen stand 10 replacement nibs (6 standard, 4 felt)
nib removal tool
Pen holder
180W AC adaptor and 1.8m power cable
1.8m USB-C to USB-C cable
3.0m DisplayPort to DisplayPort cable
3.0m HDMI2.0 to HDMI2.0 cable
3.0m standard USB-A to USB-A cable
DisplayPort to Mini DisplayPort adapter
Quick Start Guide
